VIDEO SCRIPT: VIRTUES IN ISLAM PROMISE MANAGEMENT
Grade: Grade 8 · Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION

[0:00–0:20] HOOK
• Host: “Today we learn Virtues in Islam promise management. Watch the example, then you try.”

[0:20–2:00] TEACH
• explain the teachings on fulfilment of promise and anger management according to the sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.)
• describe ways in which Muslims can manage anger for harmonious co-existence in the society
• practise fulfilment of promise and anger management as commanded in Islam
• appreciate fulfilment of promise and anger management as virtues in Islam

[2:00–4:00] WORKED EXAMPLE ON SCREEN
• Model 1: explain the teachings on fulfilment of promise and anger management according to the sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.)
• Model 2: describe ways in which Muslims can manage anger for harmonious co-existence in the society
• Model 3: practise fulfilment of promise and anger management as commanded in Islam
• Model 4: appreciate fulfilment of promise and anger management as virtues in Islam

[4:00–5:00] TRY THIS (PAUSE)
• Practise: explain the teachings on fulfilment of promise and anger management according to the sunnah of the Prophet (S.A.W.)
• Practise: describe ways in which Muslims can manage anger for harmonious co-existence in the society
• Practise: practise fulfilment of promise and anger management as commanded in Islam

[5:00–5:30] REMEMBER + CTA
• Recap 3 bullets. “Now open Revision Quiz for Virtues in Islam promise management.”
